ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 13

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 10

7. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 12
   C. 5
   D. 11

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

13. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 4

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 15
   D. 22

21. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
